name: tubecrew
description: A YouTube production crew for coding agents: evidence-based topics, sourced facts, human-sounding scripts, code gates for voiceover, render and thumbnails, dubbing, private uploads, retention and channel analytics.

interface.shortDescription: Make YouTube videos with gates: research, script, render checks, private upload
interface.longDescription: tubecrew turns a coding agent into a YouTube production line. Topics come from competitor outliers, every number has a source, scripts are humanized and reviewed, voiceover, render and thumbnails are checked in code, and uploads stay private until a human publishes or schedules them.
